modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: organise work as per organisation’s current health, safety and security policies and procedures
report any identified breaches in health, safety, and security policies and procedures to the designated person
identify the risks and hazards associated with work activities, their causes and prevention

modules.module_title: Perform work as per quality standards

pcs.pc_description: ensure work area is clean and tidy
ensure that work is accomplished as per the requirements within the specified timeline
ensure team goals are given preference over individual goals
sanitize workstation and equipment regularly
clean hands with soap, alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques
identify ways to optimise usage of material in various tasks/activities/processes
use resources, including water, in a responsible manner
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
carry out routine cleaning of tools, machines and equipment
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
report malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use
identify recyclable and non-recyclable, and hazardous waste generated
segregate waste into different categories
dispose non-recyclable waste appropriately
deposit recyclable and reusable material at identified location
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste

modules.module_title: Prepare for cleaning of exterior and interior of vehicle

pcs.pc_description: identify various interior & exterior segments of the vehicle, such as seat, dash panel, engine compartment, bonnet, dickey etc. and detachable accessories such as foot-mats, mobile charger etc.
obtain the instructions from the supervisor regarding the routine washing, cleaning and any other specific cleaning requirements
identify and collect appropriate material, tools & equipment such as cleaning agent, polish, mops, vacuum cleaner, washer, steamer etc. and notify supervisor in case of any malfunctions
mix cleaning solutions, abrasive compositions or other compounds as advised by supervisor and pre-soak or rinse given mechanical parts
transport materials, removed parts/components or supplies to or from work areas, using carts or hoists
work carefully to ensure no damage is caused to any aggregate/component of the vehicle
remove detachable items and check that no customer belongings are left inside the vehicle, and if found, deposit with service advisor

modules.module_title: Perform cleaning of exterior and interior of vehicle

pcs.pc_description: rinse removable/detachable objects and place them on drying racks
perform washing and cleaning of various segment and surfaces of the vehicle body as per OEM Standard Operating Procedure
use cloth, squeegees or air compressors to clean and dry the surfaces
perform various surface treatment on different surfaces as per OEM Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and specifications
record the details of various treatment and washing completion in job card
clean washing platform post vehicle wash
sweep, shovel or vacuum loose debris or scrap into containers
dispose debris/scrap containers as per organisation's policy
